title: Variable Creation Challenge
instructions: Your goal is to successfully create two variables using proper naming conventions and print their values to the console.
steps: Create a variable named `project_name` and assign it the string value "PyGame".
Create a variable named `hours_spent` and assign it an integer value of `45`.
starterCode:
# Create your two variables here:


# Print their values below:
solution:
# Create your two variables here:
project_name = "PyGame"
hours_spent = 45

# Print their values below:
print(project_name)
print(hours_spent)
hints: Make sure your variable names use `snake_case` (lowercase with underscores).
Strings need quotation marks around them (single or double quotes).
Numbers do not need quotation marks.
Use print() to display each variable's value on separate lines.

tests.name: Check project_name variable exists with correct value
Check hours_spent variable exists with correct value
Check output contains both values
